table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	NTN = MAX(S.NTNNo),
	Supplier = A.Name,
	SuppInvCode=MAX(P.SuppInvCode),
	PurInvCode=MAX(P.PurInvCode),
	PurDate = MAX(P.Date),
	PaymentDate = MAX(PM.Date),
	InvoiceAmt = SUM(PM.OutstandingAmt),
	WhTaxPerc=MAX(PM.WhTaxPerc),
	WhTaxAmt = SUM(PM.WhTaxAmt),
	ChequeAmt = SUM(PM.PaymentAmt)
FROM
	Accounts A,
	Supplier S,
	PurPayment PM,
	PurLedger P
WHERE 
	PM.AccCode IN (:ai_suppcode) AND
	PM.AccCode = S.SuppCode AND
	S.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND
	PM.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	PM.WhTaxAmt <> 0 AND
	PM.PurInvCode = P.PurInvCode
GROUP BY
	A.Name
ORDER BY
	Supplier,
	PaymentDate

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: 'TAX DEDUCTION STATEMENT FROM ' +  string(adt_startdate , 'DD-MM-YYYY') + '    TO ' + string(adt_enddate , 'DD-MM-YYYY')
